source.boundsContext: ItemDisplay NONE, native Minecraft Y+180, entity transform identity, entity yaw 0; exact item model faces after resolving parent models and element rotations.
source.boundsMeaning: entity-root-relative AABB after NONE context and native ItemDisplay base rotation; no world translation or table offset.
source.fitRule: min(0.65, 0.80/width, 1.05/height, 0.65/depth); ignore zero-extent axis; all dimensions must be finite and at least one dimension positive.

curation.scope: Current active priced entries from docs/furniture/catalog.json. Includes household furniture, modular sofa/bank sections, room fixtures and crafted display decor. The six generate:false PotionShop models with unverified client CustomStack/CMD mappings are excluded as unavailable even though their source model files resolve.
